obadiah.1.p1.b1.text: This is the vision of Obadiah: This is what the Lord GOD says about Edom

obadiah.1.p1.b2.text: We have heard a message from the LORD; an envoy has been sent among the nations to say,

obadiah.1.p1.b3.text: Rise up, and let us go to battle against her!

obadiah.1.p1.b4.text: “Behold, I will make you small among the nations; you will be deeply despised.

obadiah.1.p1.b5.text: The pride of your heart has deceived you, O dwellers in the clefts of the rocks whose habitation is the heights,

obadiah.1.p1.b6.text: who say in your heart, ‘Who can bring me down to the ground?’

obadiah.1.p1.b7.text: Though you soar like the eagle and make your nest among the stars, even from there I will bring you down,” declares the LORD.

obadiah.1.p2.b1.text: If thieves came to you, if robbers by night— oh, how you will be ruined— would they not steal only what they wanted?

obadiah.1.p2.b2.text: If grape gatherers came to you, would they not leave some gleanings?

obadiah.1.p2.b3.text: But how Esau will be pillaged, his hidden treasures sought out!

obadiah.1.p2.b4.text: All the men allied with you will drive you to the border; the men at peace with you will deceive and overpower you.

obadiah.1.p2.b5.text: Those who eat your bread will set a trap for you without your awareness of it.

obadiah.1.p2.b6.text: In that day, declares the LORD, will I not destroy the wise men of Edom and the men of understanding in the mountains of Esau?

obadiah.1.p2.b7.text: Then your mighty men, O Teman, will be terrified, so that everyone in the mountains of Esau will be cut down in the slaughter.

obadiah.1.p3.b1.text: Because of the violence against your brother Jacob, you will be covered with shame and cut off forever.

obadiah.1.p3.b2.text: while strangers carried off his wealth and foreigners entered his gate

obadiah.1.p3.b3.text: On the day you stood aloof … you were just like one of them.

obadiah.1.p3.b5.text: But you should not gloat in that day, your brother’s day of misfortune,

obadiah.1.p3.b6.text: You should not enter the gate of My people in the day of their disaster,

obadiah.1.p3.b7.text: nor loot their wealth in the day of their disaster.

obadiah.1.p3.b8.text: Nor should you stand at the crossroads to cut off their fugitives, nor deliver up their survivors in the day of their distress.

obadiah.1.p4.b1.text: For the Day of the LORD is near for all the nations. As you have done, it will be done to you; your recompense will return upon your own head.

obadiah.1.p4.b2.text: For as you drank on My holy mountain, so all the nations will drink continually.

obadiah.1.p4.b3.text: They will drink and gulp it down; they will be as if they had never existed.

obadiah.1.p4.b4.text: But on Mount Zion there will be deliverance, and it will be holy, and the house of Jacob will reclaim their possession.

obadiah.1.p4.b5.text: Then the house of Jacob will be a blazing fire, and the house of Joseph a burning flame; but the house of Esau will be stubble

obadiah.1.p4.b6.text: Jacob will set it ablaze and consume it. Therefore no survivor will remain from the house of Esau. For the LORD has spoken.

obadiah.1.p5.b1.text: Those from the Negev will possess the mountains of Esau; those from the foothills will possess the land of the Philistines. They will occupy the fields of Ephraim and Samaria, and Benjamin will possess Gilead.

obadiah.1.p5.b2.text: And the exiles of this host of the Israelites will possess the land of the Canaanites as far as Zarephath; and the exiles from Jerusalem who are in Sepharad will possess the cities of the Negev.

obadiah.1.p5.b3.text: The deliverers will ascend Mount Zion to rule over the mountains of Esau.

obadiah.1.p5.b4.text: And the kingdom will belong to the LORD.
